lines.en: label futabaspecial60p2:
scene parrotpicture1
scene parrotpicture2
scene futabanodokabook1
: What the fuck is this?
lines.zh: : 这他妈是什么东西？

lines.en: : Uh-oh.
lines.zh: : 哦豁。

lines.en: : Well, hello Futaba. You’re looking lovely tonight.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你好啊 Futaba。你今晚看起来真漂亮。

lines.en: : Nodoka, what the fuck is this?
lines.zh: : Nodoka，这他妈是什么东西？

lines.en: : I believe that is called a “book.”
lines.zh: : 我想，那玩意儿叫「书」。

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook2
: Nodoka!
lines.zh: : Nodoka！

lines.en: : You don’t have to yell. I’m right here. You asked what it was and I told you what it was. I’m not sure what else you want from me.
lines.zh: : 你不用喊。我就在这儿。你问它是什么，我就告诉你它是什么。我不确定你还想从我这儿得到什么。

lines.en: : I want to know what possessed you to write this! That’s what!
lines.zh: : 我想知道你到底被什么附体了才写出这种东西！就是这个！

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook3
: Artistic vision, I suppose? The endless font of creativity that is my brain? The abundance of hormones flowing through my body like blood due to living in a dorm with nineteen other girls?
lines.zh: : 艺术愿景吧，我想？我脑子里那口永不枯竭的创造力之泉？还是因为和另外十九个女生同住一栋宿舍，导致像血液一样在我体内奔流的过剩荷尔蒙？

lines.en: : The possibilities are endless. {i}Anything{/i} could have compelled me to write that book. The motivation matters not, though. It’s the story itself that I want people to dissect.
lines.zh: : 可能性无穷无尽。{i}任何事{/i}都可能促使我写下那本书。不过动机并不重要。我想让人们剖析的，是故事本身。

lines.en: : I {i}know{/i} the story already. That’s why I want to know why you’re doing this.
lines.zh: : 故事我已经{i}知道{/i}了。所以我想知道的是你为什么要这么做。

lines.en: : Because it’s interesting, obviously. I wanted to try a new approach to things.
lines.zh: : 因为它很有趣，显而易见。我想试试新的做法。

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook4
: And, based on the fact that you bought it, it looks like I’ve succeeded. Thank you very much for supporting my work, Futaba. It means a lot to me.
lines.zh: : 而且从你买了它这一点来看，我似乎是成功了。非常感谢你支持我的作品，Futaba。这对我来说意义重大。

lines.en: : Is this a joke to you? Do you not see how serious I am right now?
lines.zh: : 这在你眼里是个笑话吗？你没看到我现在有多认真吗？

lines.en: : I see exactly how serious you are. But I also know that it’s only a matter of time until everything clicks and you realize that this is, in no way, meant to be malicious or evil.
lines.zh: : 我看得出你有多认真。但我也知道，迟早有一天你会想通，然后意识到这绝不是出于恶意或邪恶。

lines.en: : Tell me, how far into the book did you make it before you stormed over to my room? You’re the first person involved who’s actually {i}read{/i} it, so I’m genuinely curious.
lines.zh: : 告诉我，在冲到我房间来之前，你读到第几页了？你是相关的人里第一个真正{i}读过{/i}它的，所以我真的很好奇。

lines.en: : Otoha, get out.
lines.zh: : Otoha，出去。

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook5
: Yup. Bye.
lines.zh: : 好嘞。拜拜。

lines.en: : I can’t believe you...Why would you do something like this?
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信你……你为什么要做这种事？

lines.en: : Has your creativity dried up? Have you gotten so tired of coming up with your own stories that you had to steal {i}ours{/i} instead?
lines.zh: : 你的创造力枯竭了吗？你已经厌倦了编自己的故事，非得来偷{i}我们的{/i}？

lines.en: : Quite the opposite, actually. And it’s not as if my new series is a perfect retelling. I can’t be everywhere at once, of course.
lines.zh: : 事实恰恰相反。而且我这个新系列又不是完美的复述。我当然不可能同时出现在所有地方。

lines.en: : Some...creative liberties needed to be taken to compensate for things I wasn’t present for.
lines.zh: : 为了弥补我不在场的那些部分，我不得不做一些……创作上的自由发挥。

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook6
: I have known you for a {i}very{/i} long time, Nodoka. I’ve seen you make questionable decisions and I, more than anyone, understand what type of person you are.
lines.zh: : 我认识你{i}很久{/i}了，Nodoka。我见过你做出各种可疑的决定，而我比任何人都更清楚你是哪一种人。

lines.en: : I am sensing a disconnect between your words and your actions right now. If you understand, what’s there to get so up in arms over?
lines.zh: : 我感觉到你此刻的言行之间有一道裂痕。如果你真的理解，那又有什么值得这么激动的？

lines.en: : I have stuck up for you {i}countless{/i} times. I’ve fought for you when no one else “got it.” And I’ve been calling you one of my biggest inspirations for years.
lines.zh: : 我为你出头过{i}无数{/i}次。在所有人都「不懂」的时候，我为你据理力争。而且这么多年来，我一直说你是我最大的灵感来源之一。

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook7
: But {i}this?...{/i}I don’t understand. {i}Why?{/i}
lines.zh: : 可{i}这件事{/i}？……我不明白。{i}为什么{/i}？

lines.en: : I believe “Why not?” is just as valid of a question here if you’re unable to come up with an answer yourself, Futaba. What do you believe is wrong about writing a story based on one’s experiences?
lines.zh: : 如果你自己想不出答案，Futaba，我认为「为什么不？」在这里同样是个合理的问题。你觉得，把自己的经历写成故事，有什么不对？

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook8
: Is that not one of the many methods of tackling fiction?
lines.zh: : 那不正是处理虚构作品的众多手法之一吗？

lines.en: : Drawing parallels between real life and make-believe worlds? Connecting them in new, thought-provoking ways? Teaching people lessons they’d never learn otherwise?
lines.zh: : 在现实与虚构的世界之间画出平行？用全新的、引人思考的方式把两者连起来？教给人们他们否则永远学不会的东西？

lines.en: : For what reason would I {i}not{/i} write this book? There’s simply far too much I’m able to teach with its concept for me to just {i}overlook{/i} it or actively decide {i}against{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 我有什么理由{i}不写{/i}这本书？光是它的概念就能让我教出太多东西，我不可能{i}视而不见{/i}，更不可能主动{i}放弃{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s an invasion of privacy, Nodoka. I don’t want my whole life inside one of your books. And that’s not even mentioning how anyone else would feel if they read this...
lines.zh: : 这是对隐私的侵犯，Nodoka。我不想要我整个人生出现在你的某本书里。更别提别人读到这个会怎么想了……

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook9
: Then I suppose I should be happy that it’s only you and I who regularly read. Besides, I’m sure the unnamed masses will take something from it. It doesn’t need to be {i}us{/i} per se.
lines.zh: : 那我想我该感到高兴，毕竟经常看书的只有你和我。再说了，我相信那些无名的读者会从中获得些什么。那不一定非得是{i}我们{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s just...it feels so...{i}invasive.{/i} And I’m only three chapters in.
lines.zh: : 只是……这感觉太……太{i}侵犯{/i}人了。而我才读到第三章。

lines.en: : Oh, wow. So you haven’t even gotten to the {i}good{/i} parts yet. I’ll have to put that in my notes.
lines.zh: : 哦，哇。这么说你连{i}精彩{/i}的部分都还没看到。我得把这个记进我的笔记里。

lines.en: : You’re really going to keep going through with this?
lines.zh: : 你真的要继续做下去？

lines.en: : Of course. You haven’t given me a good reason not to yet.
lines.zh: : 当然。你到现在还没给我一个像样的理由叫我停手。

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook10
: Then...if I say I’ll stop talking to you if you follow through with this...is {i}that{/i} a good enough reason?
lines.zh: : 那么……如果我说，你要是真做到底，我就再也不跟你说话了……{i}这{/i}算是个够好的理由吗？

lines.en: : Good? No. Threatening? Yes. Losing you is an outcome I’d like to avoid if at all possible. But I also believe I know you well enough by now to ascertain that this is a bluff of sorts.
lines.zh: : 够好？不。算威胁？算。失去你是我无论如何都想避免的结果。但我也相信，我已经足够了解你，可以断定这多少是在虚张声势。

lines.en: : I believe the whole truth is that you will do absolutely nothing if I continue to publish this book as doing so would go against your character.
lines.zh: : 我相信全部的真相是：如果我把这本书继续出版下去，你什么都不会做，因为那样做不符合你的性格。

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook11
: You only know that because I {i}am{/i} just a character to you, aren’t I?! I’m just a pawn you can move around in your book to keep your story interesting!
lines.zh: : 你之所以知道，只是因为我在你眼里不过{i}是{/i}个角色，对不对？！我只是你书里的一枚棋子，任你摆布，好让你的故事保持有趣！

lines.en: : If you actually cared about me, you wouldn’t...dehumanize all of us like this!
lines.zh: : 如果你真的在乎我，你就不会……把我们所有人这样非人化！

lines.en: : You’re likely only saying that because you haven’t reached {i}your{/i} character’s introduction yet. Read that before condemning me as some sort of malicious chess master.
lines.zh: : 你会这么说，大概只是因为你还没读到{i}你那个{/i}角色的登场。先读了再把我批判成什么邪恶的棋手吧。

lines.en: scene black
: Fine. Where do I-
lines.zh: : 好。我从哪——

lines.en: : Page 99. Much of the book is a blur to me as it was written while I was mentally exploding, but I remember that one.
lines.zh: : 第 99 页。这本书的大部分内容对我来说都是一片模糊，因为是在我精神爆炸的状态下写的，但那一页我记得。

lines.en: : Fubuki was a breath of fresh air — a lone butterfly in an eclipse of moths. But if you asked her, she’d likely tell you she was nothing more than a caterpillar.
lines.zh: : Fubuki 是一缕清新的空气——月食般的一群飞蛾中，一只孤独的蝴蝶。但如果你去问她，她多半会告诉你，自己不过是一条毛毛虫。

lines.en: : Despite that, she wasn’t the type of girl to stand out in a crowd. She didn’t {i}need{/i} to be, though.
lines.zh: : 尽管如此，她并不是那种会在人群里显眼的女孩。不过她也不{i}需要{/i}。

lines.en: : In fact, it was probably better she clung to the background as it meant {i}my{/i} eyes could taint her the most.
lines.zh: : 事实上，她黏在背景里或许更好，因为那样{i}我的{/i}目光才能最大程度地玷污她。

lines.en: : But...even with that said...she was so pure and so beautiful that it would take...years of gazing into {i}hers{/i} to make even the slightest change...
lines.zh: : 可是……即便如此……她是那么纯洁、那么美丽，要凝视{i}她的{/i}双眼……好多年，才能让她产生哪怕最微小的改变……

lines.en: : Nodoka, this doesn’t-
lines.zh: : Nodoka，这不能——

lines.en: : Keep reading.
lines.zh: : 继续读。

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}She had trouble accepting love because she felt it was misdirected. But the only reason she felt that way at all was...was because of the eclipse...
lines.zh: : {i}哈{/i}……她难以接受爱，因为她觉得那份爱投错了方向。而她之所以会有那种感觉，全都是……全都是因为那场月食……

lines.en: : She’d spent so long among the moths that...each flap of her wings served {i}not{/i} to guide her deeper into the mouth of the sky, but...further away from the light the others flocked to.
lines.zh: : 她在飞蛾中间待得太久了，以至于……她每一次扇动翅膀，都{i}不是{/i}为了把自己引向天空更深处的入口，而是……离其他飞蛾簇拥的那束光越来越远。

lines.en: : The sad reality at play here is that she would have glowed brighter than any of them. That she {i}would{/i} stand out if she only allowed herself to...
lines.zh: : 其中的可悲现实是，她{i}本可以{/i}比它们任何一个都更耀眼。只要她允许自己，她本可以脱颖而出……

lines.en: : But alas...the scourge of undesired uniqueness makes it harder to break free from refurbished chrysalides. And so the...never-ending cycle of misplaced doubt went down with the moon-
lines.zh: : 可惜啊……那份不被需要的独特所带来之灾，让她更难从翻新过的蛹里挣脱出来。于是那……错位的怀疑的无尽循环，随月亮一同落下——

lines.en: : Only to rise again the following night.
lines.zh: : 又在第二夜重新升起。

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook12
: {i}How I long to be a new light — one that guides her to the deepest lakes of sugar water so she can drink in me and feel renewed.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我多想成为一束新的光——一束能引她去往最深的糖水之湖的光，好让她把我饮下，感到重生。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}If only those wings would stop getting caught on themselves...if only I was brighter.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}要是那双翅膀不再缠住自己就好了……要是我更亮一点就好了。{/i}

lines.en: : That wasn’t all bad, was it?
lines.zh: : 那也不全是坏话吧？

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook13
: No...it was very sweet. But it changes {i}nothing,{/i} Nodoka. You did this without even talking to any of us.
lines.zh: : 不……写得很温柔。但这改变不了{i}什么{/i}，Nodoka。你做这件事，连跟我们任何人商量都没有。

lines.en: : Why would I do that? You’d all just refuse to participate and then I wouldn’t have a book at all.
lines.zh: : 我为什么要那么做？你们全都会拒绝参与，那我就一本书也写不成了。

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook14
: That’s the whole point! You’re doing something that you {i}know{/i} none of us would agree to, and yet you’re not seeing any sort of issue with it!
lines.zh: : 问题就在这儿！你在做一件你{i}明知{/i}我们谁都不会同意的事，却还看不出这有什么问题！

lines.en: : Yes, because it isn’t up to any of you to determine what I do or do not write. If something piques my interest, I’m inclined to dive further into it. I assumed you’d know that by now.
lines.zh: : 是的，因为我写什么、不写什么，不是由你们任何人来决定的。如果某件事勾起了我的兴趣，我就倾向于往深处钻研。我以为你到现在已经知道了。

lines.en: : I do, but that doesn’t mean I have to like it!
lines.zh: : 我是知道，可那不代表我就得喜欢！

lines.en: : I’m confused. No one is asking you to {i}like{/i} it. And it seems as if you’re taking exception to the existence of such a trait all on its own.
lines.zh: : 我不太明白。没有人要求你{i}喜欢{/i}它。而且看起来，你是在对这种特质本身的存在表示不满。

lines.en: : That trait is fine when it’s not causing you to spill all of our secrets into a book! This doesn’t do any good for anyone but you!
lines.zh: : 那种特质只要没让你把我们所有的秘密都倒进一本书里，就没问题！这件事除了对你自己，对谁都没有好处！

lines.en: : It’s not as if I’m exempt from exposing {i}my{/i} secrets as well, Futaba. There’s no author bias here. I’ll be just as naked as the rest of you come the final installment.
lines.zh: : 我又没有豁免{i}自己{/i}暴露秘密，Futaba。这里不存在作者偏袒。到了最后一卷，我会和你们其他人一样赤裸。

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook15
: But Nodoka...none of us should {i}be{/i} naked. Our secrets are meant to be {i}secrets.{/i} They’re not building blocks for your fictional exposé.
lines.zh: : 可是 Nodoka……我们谁都不该{i}赤裸{/i}。我们的秘密本来就该是{i}秘密{/i}。它们不是你那篇虚构揭秘文的砖块。

lines.en: : They quite literally are though.
lines.zh: : 可它们从字面上来说就是啊。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook16

: Well, the idea of an exposé is to reveal the true nature of something. So even if you tack a prefix like “fictional” onto it, it’s still fulfilling a key purpose by bringing a certain truth to light.
lines.zh: : 嗯，揭秘文的意义就在于揭示某件事的真实本质。所以就算你给它加上「虚构」这样的前缀，它依然在实现一个关键目的——把某种真相公之于众。

lines.en: : And truth is determined by history. Which is determined by specific examples and accounts from real life events.
lines.zh: : 而真相由历史决定。历史又由现实事件中的具体例子与记述决定。

lines.en: : But I suppose things get muddier when there is an assumption to be made about truth in the context of a fictional world.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，当要在虚构世界的语境中对真相做出假定时，事情就会变得模糊了。

lines.en: : What?...I didn’t understand any of that.
lines.zh: : 什么？……我一句都没听懂。

lines.en: : Sorry, I’m trying to figure out a way to explain it that would be coherent to someone else.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我在想办法用别人也能听懂的方式把它说清楚。

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook17
: But I suppose the gist is that the “secrets” you and everyone else share are the closest I can get to examples and accounts of real life happenings.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，大意是：你和所有人分享的那些「秘密」，是我能拿到的最接近现实事件的例子与记述的东西。

lines.en: : Which could then become building blocks to better lay out my fictional reconstruction of our reality so it can be shared and understood by people who aren’t with us to experience it firsthand.
lines.zh: : 然后它们就能变成砖块，好让我把我们现实的虚构重建铺陈得更清楚，让那些不在我们身边、无法亲身经历的人也能分享并理解它。

lines.en: : Why do other people have to experience it at all? Why can’t it just be for us?
lines.zh: : 为什么别人非得去体验它？为什么它不能只属于我们？

lines.en: : Because people like {i}us{/i} live for this. We need stories like this to exist because life isn’t interesting unless we can compare and contrast it with a fabricated version.
lines.zh: : 因为像{i}我们{/i}这样的人就是为这个而活的。我们需要这样的故事存在，因为生活本身并不有趣，除非我们能拿它和一个虚构的版本比较、对照。

lines.en: : Out of the hundreds of books you’ve read, I’d wager at least half of them were someone’s reality at some point. What I do is no different from that. You’re just on the opposite end for once.
lines.zh: : 你读过的几百本书里，我敢打赌至少有一半在某个时刻曾是某个人的现实。我做的和那没什么不同。只是这一次你站在了另一端。

lines.en: : Nodoka, {i}I don’t like being on the opposite end.{/i} I don’t want people to know how I feel or what I’m doing. And I’m afraid of what will happen to me if people find out.
lines.zh: : Nodoka，{i}我不喜欢站在另一端{/i}。我不想让别人知道我的感受，也不想让别人知道我在做什么。而且我害怕别人发现之后，我会变成什么样。

lines.en: : Then why are you doing such a piss poor job of hiding it all?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么把这些藏得这么糟糕？

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook18
: {i}Excuse me?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你说什么？{/i}

lines.en: : I’m just not sure I understand the rationale behind revealing your truths to someone else if you don’t want anyone to {i}know{/i} those truths. It’s no longer a secret once it crosses your tongue, correct?
lines.zh: : 我只是不确定我理解这背后的逻辑：如果你不想让任何人{i}知道{/i}那些真相，为什么还要把它们透露给别人？话一出口，它就不再是秘密了，对吧？

lines.en: : So because I shared something with you...something I told you in confidence because you are my {i}friend...{/i}it means that I don’t understand what a secret is? That I want {i}everyone else{/i} to know?
lines.zh: : 所以就因为我把一些事告诉了你……一些因为你是我的{i}朋友{/i}、我才推心置腹告诉你的事……就意味着我不懂什么是秘密？就意味着我想让{i}所有人{/i}都知道？

lines.en: : But...no one else knows. All I did was use {i}your{/i} experiences to create {i}new{/i} ones for {i}someone else.{/i} And if that someone else is a product of my imagination, shouldn’t I be able to share those things?
lines.zh: : 可是……没有{i}别人{/i}知道啊。我所做的，只是拿{i}你的{/i}经历去为别人创造{i}新的{/i}经历。而如果那个别人是我虚构出来的产物，我难道不能分享那些东西吗？

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook19

: No! Because it’s not someone else! It’s us! It’s me! That’s what I’ve been trying to tell you this whole time! So you’re either trying to manipulate me right now or you just flat out lack common sense!
lines.zh: : 不能！因为那根本不是别人！那就是我们！就是我！我从头到尾想告诉你的就是这个！所以你要么是在操纵我，要么就是干脆没有常识！

lines.en: : Which one of those two do you think it is?
lines.zh: : 你觉得是这两个里的哪一个？

lines.en: : I don’t care which one it is! I just want it to stop!
lines.zh: : 我不在乎是哪一个！我只想让它停下来！

lines.en: : Then stop clutching the book so close to your chest and just burn it or something. No one is forcing you to read it. That’s a decision you made yourself.
lines.zh: : 那就别把那本书紧紧抱在胸前了，烧了它之类的都行。没有人逼你读它。那是你自己做的决定。

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook20
: In fact, I’d {i}urge{/i} you to stop reading it if the first three chapters were enough to impact you to this extent. It only gets messier from then on, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 事实上，如果前三章就足以让你受到这么大的冲击，我倒是{i}劝{/i}你别再读了。从那之后只会越来越糟，Futaba。

lines.en: : I’m sure you know that already, though. But hey, maybe if you {i}do{/i} continue, you’ll enjoy seeing things from someone else’s perspective as it will show you just how everyone else views {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不过我想你已经知道了。可是呢，也许如果你{i}继续{/i}读下去，你会享受从别人的视角看事情——因为它会让{i}你{/i}看到，其他人究竟是怎么看你的。

lines.en: : I seriously can’t believe you...you’re not getting it at all. You don’t see {i}any{/i} problem with this.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信你……你根本没明白。你看不出这有{i}什么{/i}问题。

lines.en: : I see that...{i}you{/i} have a problem with it. And acknowledge that others directly involved may as well.
lines.zh: : 我看得出来……{i}你{/i}对它有意见。我也承认，其他直接牵涉其中的人可能也有意见。

lines.en: : But I’d also implore all of those people, yourself included, to remember that this book is just, for lack of a better word-
lines.zh: : 但我也想恳请那些所有人，包括你自己在内，记住这本书只不过——找不到更好的词——

lines.en: : A rectangle.
lines.zh: : 一个长方形。

lines.en: : And it will remain a rectangle until someone comes along and sees it as anything else.
lines.zh: : 而在某个人出现、把它看成别的东西之前，它就只是一个长方形。

lines.en: : Unbelievable...You’re seriously unbelievable.
lines.zh: : 难以置信……你真是让人难以置信。

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook21
: See, this is precisely why I never make a big deal out of anything I do. No one else ever looks at things the same way as me.
lines.zh: : 看吧，这正是我为什么从来不把自己做的事闹大。没有别的人会用和我一样的方式看待事物。

lines.en: : It’s incredibly exhausting never getting through to people when that is quite literally my job.
lines.zh: : 明明让别人理解我根本就是我的工作，却永远做不到，这真的让人精疲力竭。

lines.en: : You know what else is exhausting? Having a best friend who cares more about {i}herself{/i} than your feelings.
lines.zh: : 你知道还有什么让人精疲力竭吗？有一个关心{i}自己{/i}胜过关心你感受的挚友。

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook22
: Would you not do the same? Just because you prioritize yourself over someone else doesn’t mean that you don’t love them.
lines.zh: : 你不也会这么做吗？你把自己放在别人前面，并不代表你就不爱他们了。

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook23
: And I-
lines.zh: : 而我——

lines.en: : ...Futaba?
lines.zh: : ...Futaba？

lines.en: : Why are you crying? Was it something I said?
lines.zh: : 你为什么哭了？是我说了什么吗？

lines.en: : I hope you’re happy, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 我希望你开心，Nodoka。

lines.en: : I really hope you are.
lines.zh: : 我真的很希望你开心。

lines.en: scene futabanodokabook24
: Futaba, wait. I don’t think you’re necessarily understanding what-
lines.zh: : Futaba，等等。我觉得你未必理解了——

: Huh.
